title: Lawyers' agitation is about being heard, not confrontation: DHCBA President N Hariharan
description: Delhi High Court Bar Association (DHCBA) President and Senior Advocate N Hariharan has said that the Bar’s agitation against the proposed increase in the pecuniary jurisdiction of Delhi’s district courts was aimed at ensuring that lawyers were heard before a decision was taken.Addressing the Intellectual Property (IP) Bar, who were protesting till Thursday, Hariharan said that the DHCBA recognised the impact of inflation and the accumulation of cases before the Delhi High Court’s Original Side.
